title: Advanced Paste: As of v0.96.0, doesn't work, at all, unless clipboard history is turned on

status.label: Guard clipboard-history availability check
status.detail: Advanced Paste fails when Windows Clipboard History is disabled; the reporter supplied exact steps, an access-denied stack trace, and a still-broken confirmation.

next_action.label: Approve a narrow guard around history availability and reproduce with Clipboard History disabled.
next_action.reason: The stack trace identifies the unguarded call present in current source; supplied steps already establish the environment and no additional reporter diagnostics are needed.

judgment.rationale: The stack trace identifies the unguarded call present in current source; supplied steps already establish the environment and no additional reporter diagnostics are needed.
judgment.recommended_action: Approve a narrow guard around history availability and reproduce with Clipboard History disabled.

fix_assessment.rationale: The reported access-denied exception originates at an unchecked optional history probe; make that probe non-fatal and retain current-clipboard behavior.

proposed_fixes.title: Treat clipboard-history availability failures as optional
proposed_fixes.root_cause: Clipboard.IsHistoryEnabled() is outside local exception handling although the reported UnauthorizedAccessException originates at that probe when history is disabled.
plan: Put the availability probe in a narrowly scoped exception-handling path.
On unavailable/denied history, continue using clipboard sequence/format changes and current clipboard data.
Add tests for a throwing availability probe and normal history timestamps.
verification: With history disabled, Advanced Paste opens and uses current clipboard without an unhandled exception.
With history enabled, history-backed timestamps and previews remain unchanged.

confidence.rationale: The supplied stack identifies the API and pinned source calls it outside the local catch; the change is narrowly scoped to making history optional.

issue_context.summary: Advanced Paste fails when Windows Clipboard History is disabled; the reporter supplied exact steps, an access-denied stack trace, and a still-broken confirmation.
known_information: Report is PowerToys 0.97.1 and supplies the exact Clipboard History disable sequence.
UnauthorizedAccessException stack trace ends at Clipboard.IsHistoryEnabled() in OptionsViewModel.UpdateClipboardTimestampAsync.
Author later says it is still broken.
Current source calls Clipboard.IsHistoryEnabled() before the local try/catch around history enumeration.
inferences: The unchecked availability probe can throw when history service is unavailable, interrupting a path that should still support current clipboard data.
issue_context.analysis: The supplied trace names the same API call present in current source outside the local history-enumeration catch. Treat history as optional and preserve sequence-number-based preview when the probe fails.
initial_investigation: UpdateClipboardTimestampAsync calls Clipboard.IsHistoryEnabled() before its local try/catch: src/modules/AdvancedPaste/AdvancedPaste/ViewModels/OptionsViewModel.cs.

actions.label: Reproduce with Clipboard History disabled
actions.note: The issue contains enough detail for a focused maintainer reproduction; do not request duplicate diagnostics.

reproduce.title: Verify Advanced Paste without Clipboard History
prerequisites: Windows user profile with Advanced Paste enabled
A reversible test profile or Windows Clipboard History setting
setup: Disable Clipboard History using Windows Settings; do not alter clipboard service startup type.
steps: Open Advanced Paste with its configured shortcut.
Observe whether the UI opens and can use current clipboard content.
Repeat with Clipboard History enabled as a control.
reproduce.expected_result: With history disabled, the availability check must not crash the view model; current clipboard functionality remains usable while history-only features may be unavailable.
